name: Yash Rawal
summary: AI Engineer specialized in AI Platform Engineering and enterprise LLM infrastructure for 1M+ active users. Skilled in building low-latency, secure agent execution runtimes, zero-vector-DB tool-routing layers, and AWS-native AI services. Open-source contributor to Spring AI, leveraging deep system design and security experience to ship production-scale software.

bullets: Developed full-stack applied AI workflows and multi-agent family graphs (flat orchestration and Model Context Protocol tools) on AWS Bedrock serving 1M+ active ERP users across healthcare, manufacturing, and financial services.
Addressed Ask Engine multi-agent latency by designing a capability contract layer that executes nested capability profiles inside a single ReAct loop, reducing latency by 3x and token costs by 70%.
Built a custom zero-vector-DB tool routing system on volatile RAM (using BM25F, TF-IDF, Elias encoding, and LSA fallback) to scale 1,000+ capabilities with microsecond-level latency.

Architected the Prompt Lab evaluation system for large-scale model evaluations by engineering a FastAPI + UI + n8n control plane to capture durable trajectories and human preference annotations, serving as an offline RLHF/DPO dataset factory to optimize routing policies.

Built a search platform for 10,000+ documents at an international patent authority by implementing a hierarchical RAG pipeline (indexing paragraph, page, and chapter layers) and Postgres signature deduplication, achieving 90%+ Recall@10.

Secured agentic workflows against OWASP LLM Top 10 vulnerabilities by implementing observer-based tool-call monitoring and automated PII redaction, protecting sensitive customer financial data in production.
Built clinical transcription workflows (Whisper transcription, medical NER, speech synthesis) using rule-based guardrails to extract medication schedules.
Developed LLM-based safeguards for structured extraction of medications and patient history.
